prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 2024年10月员工工资条 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 8 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "姓名" spans 1 col × 2 row; "应发" spans 3 col × 1 row; "扣款" spans 3 col × 1 row; "实发" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 17px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "姓名" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 53px
  col 2: header "应发 › 基本工资" · longest unbreakable word 70px · one-line width 70px
  col 3: header "应发 › 绩效" · longest unbreakable word 65px · one-line width 65px
  col 4: header "应发 › 补贴" · longest unbreakable word 63px · one-line width 63px
  col 5: header "扣款 › 社保" · longest unbreakable word 56px · one-line width 56px
  col 6: header "扣款 › 公积金" · longest unbreakable word 63px · one-line width 63px
  col 7: header "扣款 › 个税" · longest unbreakable word 60px · one-line width 60px
  col 8: header "实发" · longest unbreakable word 71px · one-line width 71px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 601px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 600px.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示2024年10月各员工的应发工资、扣款明细和实发金额，便于核对工资构成。","reading":"读者先按姓名定位整行，再横向核对应发、扣款和实发；也会纵向比较同一工资或扣款项目。两层表头可承接部分换行。","groups":["基本工资、绩效、补贴同属应发，都是金额列。","社保、公积金、个税同属扣款，都是金额列。","姓名用于定位员工，实发是每行最重要的最终金额。"],"keep_intact":["员工姓名应尽量保持完整，避免行身份难以辨认。","金额及其小数部分应尽量保持在同一行，尤其是实发金额；可用宽度不足以让所有列的最长内容都完整显示。"],"may_wrap":["基本工资等表头文字可自然换行，两层表头的高度可容纳换行。","空间不足时，部分金额可能被迫换行；应结合列的重要性和同组列的阅读节奏取舍。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [74, 91, 86, 63, 77, 58, 59, 92] · table 601×500px · row heights [39, 66, 66, 66, 66, 66, 66, 66] · column headers wrapped 1/10 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 18
Design r2B: widths [74, 91, 86, 73, 77, 67, 60, 72] · table 601×500px · row heights [39, 66, 66, 66, 66, 66, 66, 66] · column headers wrapped 1/10 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 24
Design r2C: widths [74, 80, 75, 70, 77, 84, 60, 80] · table 601×500px · row heights [39, 66, 66, 66, 66, 66, 66, 66] · column headers wrapped 1/10 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 29

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"姓名、基本工资、绩效、社保和实发都能保持完整，尤其实发金额便于逐行核对；应发与扣款的分组也清楚。","problems":"补贴、公积金和个税的金额频繁断行，小数部分被拆开；公积金表头也换行，扣款组的阅读节奏不均匀。","cause":"补贴63px、公积金58px、个税59px，均小于各自最长内容加内边距所需的84px、84px和81px。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"姓名、基本工资、绩效和社保保持完整；补贴与公积金列比r2A宽。","problems":"实发金额逐行断开，削弱了最终结果的可读性；补贴、公积金和个税仍然断行，增加的宽度没有消除这些列的主要问题。","cause":"实发缩至72px，低于完整显示最长金额所需的92px；补贴73px、公积金67px、个税60px也仍不足以容纳最长金额。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"姓名、社保和公积金保持完整，扣款组中公积金表头也能单行显示。","problems":"基本工资、绩效、补贴、个税及多数实发金额被拆开，横向核对一行时断行分散在整张表中；基本工资表头也换行。","cause":"基本工资80px、绩效75px、补贴70px、个税60px和实发80px均小于各自完整显示最长内容所需的宽度。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r3A","widths":[74,91,86,60,77,58,62,92],"change":"以r2A为基础，将补贴的3px让给个税。保留姓名、基本工资、绩效、社保和实发的完整显示，尝试改善个税金额的断行位置。"},{"name":"r3B","widths":[74,91,86,63,55,84,55,92],"change":"保留r2A中完整的姓名、基本工资、绩效和实发，将扣款组宽度集中给公积金，使其表头和金额完整；以社保和个税更多断行为代价，检验减少受影响列数是否改善整体扫描。"}]}
